breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the standard linear bending stress formula σ = M·y / I, which produces a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis. It does not treat the stress as uniform over the section depth. The results confirm linearity: 0 MPa at y=0 (implied), 18 MPa at y=25 mm, and 36 MPa at y=50 mm, all consistent with the flexure formula. The incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt (uniform stress distribution) was not repeated.
